description: Manifest of one agent note: durable findings written by LLM agents for LLM agents (audit results, discovered bugs, gotchas). A note is a directory notes/<id>/ holding this manifest as note.json plus any free-form payload files (markdown, JSON, images, ...). Only the manifest is validated and canonicalized; body accepts any JSON value, extra top-level fields are allowed, payload files are never rewritten. Humans only browse, search, archive, or delete.
title: Agent note
